standard_prerequisites.name: Convergence of the plus construction
standard_prerequisites.use: F^# = (F^+)^+, so it suffices to show F^+ is limit preserving.

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard fppf coverings are cofinal
standard_prerequisites.use: The colimit defining F^+(T) may be taken over standard coverings only.

standard_prerequisites.name: Schemes over limits
standard_prerequisites.use: lim T_{i',k} = T_k and the analogous fibre-product identity.

standard_prerequisites.name: Colimits commute with colimits
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies switching the order of the two colimits.

core_obligations: 化归：只需证 F^+ 保极限（F^#=(F^+)^+，sites-theorem-plus）；仿射 T=lim T_i；F^+(T) 是对 fppf 覆盖取 Cech H^0 的 colimit，标准 fppf 覆盖共尾（topologies-lemma-fppf-affine）故只对标准覆盖取（~513-530 行）。

单覆盖等式链：任一标准覆盖 V={T_k→T} 可写为 V_i×_{T_i}T；逐项验证 colim_{i'≥i} Cech H^0(V_i,F) = Equalizer(colim∏F(T_{i',k}), colim∏F(T_{i',k}×_{T_{i'}}T_{i',l})) = Equalizer(∏F(T_k), ∏F(T_k×_T T_l)) = Cech H^0(V,F)；第二等式用 filtered colimit 正合（正文明示），第三等式用 F 保极限 + limits-lemma-scheme-over-limit（~531-579 行）。
收尾：对全部覆盖同时使用得 F^+(T)=colim_i colim_{V_i standard} Cech H^0 = colim_i F^+(T_i)；colimit 换序由 categories-lemma-colimits-commute（~580-593 行）。
